integrity: The Rogers generating-function coefficient identity is pre-existing; the novel mathematical claim is the exact Mersenne-index valuation and unique-minimal-summand proof. The reported automated checks supplement the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Proves only exact 2-adic valuations at Mersenne indices with exponent r>=3; neither arbitrary-index valuation, odd unit residues at higher moduli, nor independent originality are established.
source_ids: Chan-Zudilin 2010 New representations for Apéry-like sequences
title: Sharp two-adic valuations of Mersenne-index Domb numbers
